entries.title: Colossians 2:1
segments:
I strive. In prayer and earnest counsel.
 

 
 Laodicea. A town near Colossae and Hierapolis, damaged with them by an earthquake, in the time of Nero.  It was a place of great wealth.  See

entries.title: Colossians 2:6
segments: As... ye received. According to the gospel as first preached to you.

entries.title: Colossians 2:8
segments:
Spoil. Or booty; in the sense of leading captive your understanding through deceitful reasonings.  See 2Pe 2.1, 19.
 

 
 The rudiments of the world. The elementary forces of the life of the flesh; the powers of darkness.  See

segments: Made with hands. The circumcision among the Jews was a seal of the old covenant.  Under the new covenant the circumcision of Christ was the putting off of the body of the flesh:-that is, the whole carnal nature.  See

entries.title: Colossians 2:14
segments:
In ordinances. The Jewish law.
 

 
 Against us. The law was against the nature of the people.  Through regeneration by the Spirit the nature was changed to work righteousness regardless of the law which was thus blotted out.  See

entries.title: Colossians 2:15
segments: Principalities, etc.  The invisible 'spirits of the air,' believed in as mediators and avengers.  Christ did his work openly, in the sight of all men.  See

segments: Judge you. Comdemn you- because of eating or not eating; keeping a feast day, or not keeping it.  See
